name: privacy-redactor
description: Redact personal identifiable information (PII) from text and documents while preserving semantic meaning. Local-only processing with explicit user consent. Logs redaction patterns to enable Shadow Risk Score validation.

privacyPolicy.logging: Redaction event metadata (category counts, timestamp) logged to Supabase only with explicit user consent
privacyPolicy.retention: Redaction logs retained for 30 days; user can delete anytime
